mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE root_comment_id = #{rootCommentId} AND status = 1

SELECT c.id, c.gif_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM comment c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.gif_id = #{gifId} AND c.root_comment_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.like_count >= #{minLikes} ORDER BY c.like_count DESC, c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: WITH to_delete AS ( SELECT id FROM comment WHERE status = 0 AND updated_at < #{expireTime} ), del_like AS ( DELETE FROM comment_like cl USING to_delete td WHERE cl.comment_id = td.id RETURNING 1 ) DELETE FROM comment c USING to_delete td WHERE c.id = td.id;
DELETE FROM comment_like cl WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM comment c WHERE c.id = cl.comment_id )
